mapper.select: select p.user_id,p.stage,p.grade,p.mastery_summary,p.path_summary,p.weak_points,p.point_summary, p.preference_doc_id,p.dirty,p.refresh_time,p.create_time,p.update_time from student_profile p where p.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into student_profile (user_id, stage, grade, mastery_summary, path_summary, weak_points, point_summary, dirty, refresh_time, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{stage}, #{grade}, #{masterySummary}, #{pathSummary}, #{weakPoints}, #{pointSummary}, 0, now(), now()) on duplicate key update stage = values(stage), grade = values(grade), mastery_summary = values(mastery_summary), path_summary = values(path_summary), weak_points = values(weak_points), point_summary = values(point_summary), dirty = 0, refresh_time = now()
insert into student_profile (user_id, dirty, refresh_time, create_time) values (#{userId}, 1, now(), now()) on duplicate key update dirty = 1
mapper.update: update student_profile set preference_doc_id = #{preferenceDocId} where user_id = #{userId}
